items.title: Reading and writing worsens in Australian schools as one in three students fail to meet Naplan benchmarks
items.standfirst: Education minister Jason Clare says the results showed ‘real challenges’ but numeracy scores were hearteningFollow our Australia news live blog for latest updatesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastReading and writing scores are going backwards for almost every age group in Australia’s national standardised school tests, with one in three students still failing to meet Naplan benchmarks.This year’s tests were taken in March by 1.2 million students across years 3, 5, 7 and 9 to measure literacy and numeracy proficiency, with results released on Wednesday by the Australian Curriculum, Assessment and Reporting Authority (Acara). items.title: Luke Bateman tells inquiry gambling companies gave him drugs and alcohol – video
items.standfirst: Former rugby league player turned BookTok influencer Luke Bateman has alleged to a parliamentary inquiry he was supplied with drugs by gambling company promoters at the height of his spiralling addiction. 'There were times I would be flow interstate and taken to race days, put in marquees with alcohol and food provided, but before getting there your VIP manager would [ask] ... what drugs do you want? Do you want a couple of bags for the weekend?' Bateman tells the inquiry.
